data.title: Bitcoin pinned below $65k amid rate hike fears; Strategy buys more coins
data.description: Investing.com-- Bitcoin rose slightly on Tuesday, but remained close to recent lows as fears of rising U.S. interest rates and an unclear regulatory outlook weighed on appetite for cryptocurrencies.
